title: Putin, war leader and election campaign chief, prepares Russia for military escalation

title: Frida Kahlo's paintings, the wealthy collector and her cunning friend spark a fight for Mexico's art
subhed: On September 8, part of the most important collection of modern Mexican art assembled by Jacques and Natasha Gelman will be exhibited in Spain. The future of this priceless collection now lies with the Spanish bank Santander. In Mexico, a collective fears that these paintings, considered national heritage, may never be displayed in their home country again.
